notes: The second wave of new heroes (2026-10-26): Phoenix's bomber pair, Tarn's Salamanders, Scylla the battleship, Tsunami's seaplane wing. Merged by tools/author_bonds_v1.py.

C.title: Count the passes
beats: Phoenix chalks a tally on her fuselage. Thresh has never kept one.
I never look at what I hit.
I never look at what hit me. We're nearly the same.

B.title: Who landed
beats: Both wings came home from the same raid. Phoenix's had smoke on them.
Three times. That's a quiet day.
Then you should have the better seat.

A.title: Fourth pass
beats: Thresh dropped first and cleared the air. Phoenix came back through it with the fire still on her.
You made it burn. I think that's a partnership.

C.title: Same river
beats: Tarn's Salamanders and Odessa's amphibians share a ford. Neither gives way, and neither minds.
The line goes round the lake.

B.title: Wet company
beats: They cross the flood in formation, one pack on each side of the same current.
Everyone else stopped at the bank.
Everyone else has a map. We have a bank to leave.

A.title: The far shore
beats: Both packs surfaced under the enemy line at once. The line had been looking the other way.
Already firing. I like your company.

motifs: the long gun and the longer gun

C.title: Reach
beats: Voss measures her broadside against Halq's arc on a napkin. They disagree by one hill.
My range comes with a waterline.
Then you owe me a lake.

B.title: Salvo and arc
beats: A battleship and a battery engaged the same target from opposite sides of a river.
I was on time. You were shy.

A.title: Crossfire
beats: The target had nowhere to stand. It tried anyway.
The shore was never going to be safe.
Neither was the lake. Nicely done.

motifs: two wings that land on water

C.title: Who parks where
beats: Harrow's seaplanes and Gale's Cutlasses settle on the same pond, nose to tail.

B.title: Horizon
beats: A Horizon found a column in the fog. Gale's wing was already turning before the report.
My bombs. Your guns can have the leftovers.

A.title: One pond
beats: Two wings took off together from the same flooded basin and landed on the same one.
